scope: Pakistan medical discovery — Aga Khan University Medical College

verifiedFacts.claim: AKU's Medical College publishes a five-year MBBS programme, open on merit to qualified applicants from Pakistan and overseas, with eligibility information for the 2026–27 cycle.

AKU's official MBBS 2026–2030 fee schedule lists 2026 annual tuition of PKR 1,704,000 for Pakistani students and USD 38,500 for foreign-national/non-resident Pakistani students, plus separately listed charges and hostel rates.
The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council's current private-medical-college list includes Aga Khan University Medical College, Karachi, with 100 seats.
AKU's 2026–27 MBBS page says applications for that cycle closed on 13 May 2026.

holdReasons: Although PMDC lists the college, a complete current independent programme-recognition and graduate-practice evidence packet for all required badges was not established.
A complete source-backed clinical-training narrative, accommodation availability/terms and international student-support packet was not completed.
The fee schedule projects through 2030, but a public payload must separate annual tuition from university fees and non-tuition mandatory charges with route-specific presentation.
nextAction: Complete current programme recognition and clinical/student-life evidence, then package the five-year Pakistan MBBS route with year-specific fee disclosures.
